evidence_quotes.agenda: I really wanna make sure that I'm answering all the questions that are important to you on the call. So, what are the most important things that you would like answered obviously price but are there anything, any other?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: If you offer military discounts and then also, is it by hourly or how do you guys structure it? -- rep answered both once and moved on to collecting more logistics info, no deeper follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: N/A/full credit -- 3900 sq ft two-story house cleanly routed to a specialist by design ('let me go ahead and get you to the specialist, so they can go ahead and give you that estimate'), with a full recap of both addresses and stop count confirmed before handoff.

top_strength: Patient through repeated call-quality dropouts and a not-yet-profiled customer, and correctly identified the large square footage as a specialist-routing trigger.
coaching_note: The military-discount and billing-structure questions got single flat answers with no digging into what's really driving her decision (price sensitivity, timeline) -- a quick follow-up question could have surfaced more to work with before the handoff.
